entries.en: His bright shell suit rustled as he squeezed into the back seat.
entries.zh: 他挤进后座时，那身鲜艳的薄尼龙休闲套装沙沙作响。

entries.en: The new shelving leaves enough space beneath it for the taller storage boxes.
entries.zh: 新搁板下面留出了足够的空间，可以放下较高的储物箱。

entries.en: One shin pad slipped down inside his sock during the match.
entries.zh: 比赛时，一块护腿板在他的袜子里滑了下去。

entries.en: She caught her shirt-tail on a nail while climbing over the fence.
entries.zh: 她翻越围栏时，衬衫下摆被钉子勾住了。

entries.meaningZh: 故意口无遮拦的电台主持人
entries.en: The station dismissed its shock jock after listeners complained about the interview.
entries.zh: 听众投诉那次采访后，电台解雇了那位故意口无遮拦的主持人。

entries.en: Against the grey walls, the shocking pink of the cushions looked even brighter.
entries.zh: 在灰墙的衬托下，靠垫的鲜粉红色显得更加明亮。

entries.en: We expected a quiet drama, but the film turned out to be a shoot-em-up.
entries.zh: 我们原以为是一部安静的剧情片，结果却是部枪战片。

entries.en: In the novel, the border dispute escalates into a shooting war.
entries.zh: 小说中，那场边界争端升级为热战。

entries.en: The short cut through the orchard saved us nearly twenty minutes.
entries.zh: 穿过果园的那条近路让我们省了将近二十分钟。

entries.en: We had only a short time to pack before the taxi arrived.
entries.zh: 出租车到达之前，我们只有很短的时间收拾行李。

entries.meaningZh: 只重眼前利益的短期效益主义
entries.en: She blamed short-termism for the company's repeated delays in repairing its machinery.
entries.zh: 她认为，公司一再拖延维修机器，是只重眼前利益的短期效益主义所致。

entries.en: The strap of my shoulder-bag caught on the door handle.
entries.zh: 我那只肩背手提包的带子勾在了门把手上。

entries.en: He shortened the shoulder-strap so the case would not knock against his knees.
entries.zh: 他把肩带调短了，免得箱子撞到膝盖。

entries.en: A disagreement over the bill soon became a shouting match outside the restaurant.
entries.zh: 对账单的分歧很快变成了餐馆外的一场大声争吵。

entries.en: The show jumper walked the course before bringing her horse into the arena.
entries.zh: 那位马术障碍赛骑手先步行查看了路线，再把马带进赛场。

entries.en: Rain delayed the show jumping, so we watched the horses being groomed instead.
entries.zh: 雨使马术障碍赛推迟了，于是我们转而观看给马梳洗的过程。

entries.en: A show of hands revealed that most residents wanted the playground repaired first.
entries.zh: 举手表决的结果显示，大多数居民希望先修缮游乐场。

entries.en: I managed a little shut-eye while the others drove through the night.
entries.zh: 其他人连夜开车时，我设法睡了一小会儿。

entries.meaningZh: 一天的病假〔澳大利亚口语〕
entries.en: I took a sickie when the fever made it impossible to concentrate.
entries.zh: 发烧让我无法集中注意力，我就请了一天病假。

entries.en: The colour of the chairs was a side issue compared with the cost of repairs.
entries.zh: 与维修费用相比，椅子的颜色只是个次要问题。

entries.en: My sandwich came with a side salad in a separate bowl.
entries.zh: 我的三明治配了一份单独盛在碗里的色拉。

entries.en: The committee's siege mentality made even friendly suggestions sound like attacks.
entries.zh: 委员会的受围心态使得连友善的建议听起来都像攻击。

entries.en: She wondered whether the silent majority shared the speakers' enthusiasm.
entries.zh: 她想知道，沉默的大多数是否也像发言者那样热情。

entries.en: We gathered in the garden to celebrate my parents' silver wedding.
entries.zh: 我们聚在花园里，庆祝父母的银婚。

entries.en: As a single parent, he arranged his working hours around the school day.
entries.zh: 作为单亲家长，他围绕孩子的上学时间安排自己的工作时段。

entries.en: The single-decker was almost empty when we boarded at the harbour.
entries.zh: 我们在港口上车时，那辆单层公共汽车几乎是空的。

entries.en: The siting of the new library became the main topic at the village meeting.
entries.zh: 新图书馆的选址成为村民会议的主要议题。

entries.meaningZh: 无防备的攻击目标〔非正式〕
entries.en: Without anyone to defend her proposal, she became a sitting target for the critics.
entries.zh: 没有人为她的提案辩护，她成了批评者可以轻易攻击的目标。

entries.en: The buyer arranged to meet the sitting tenant before viewing the house.
entries.zh: 买家安排在看房前与原有房客见面。

entries.meaningZh: 六年级〔英国中学最高阶段〕
entries.en: She met her closest friend during her first week in the sixth form.
entries.zh: 她在英国中学六年级的第一周认识了后来最亲密的朋友。

entries.meaningZh: 惯常逃避工作的人〔英式口语〕
entries.en: The foreman called him a skiver, although he had finished every assigned task.
entries.zh: 工头说他惯常逃避工作，可他已经完成了所有分配的任务。

entries.meaningZh: 互相谩骂的争吵〔英式非正式〕
entries.en: The discussion ended in a slanging match, and neither side answered the question.
entries.zh: 讨论以双方互相谩骂告终，谁也没有回答那个问题。

entries.en: The exhibition included photographs documenting slave labour at the abandoned mine.
entries.zh: 展览中有一些记录那座废弃矿场奴役性劳动的照片。

entries.meaningZh: 实力尚未充分展现的人
entries.en: Her coach called her a sleeping giant after seeing her first competitive race.
entries.zh: 看过她的首场正式比赛后，教练称她为实力尚未充分展现的选手。

entries.en: A sleeve note explained why the final track sounded different from the others.
entries.zh: 唱片套上的一则文字说明解释了最后一首曲目为何听起来与其他曲目不同。

entries.en: The slimmer in the story grew tired of everyone's unsolicited comments about her meals.
entries.zh: 故事中的那位减肥者厌烦了大家未经请求便对她的饮食指指点点。

entries.en: She lifted the dumplings from the pan with a slotted spoon.
entries.zh: 她用篦式漏勺把饺子从锅里捞了出来。

entries.en: The museum kept the small arms separate from the uniforms and medals.
entries.zh: 博物馆把轻武器与制服、勋章分开放置。

entries.en: The play reached a much wider audience when it moved to the small screen.
entries.zh: 那部戏剧搬上电视后，观众范围扩大了许多。

entries.en: Their small-mindedness turned a minor difference of artistic taste into a lasting quarrel.
entries.zh: 他们的心胸狭窄把一点审美分歧变成了一场长久的争执。

entries.meaningZh: 自作聪明的人〔口语，贬义〕
entries.en: Nobody appreciated the smart alec who interrupted every answer with another joke.
entries.zh: 那个自作聪明的人总用新的笑话打断每一次回答，没人喜欢他这样做。

entries.en: The documentary questioned the promises made in an advertisement for a smart drug.
entries.zh: 纪录片质疑了一则所谓健脑药物广告中作出的承诺。

entries.en: Her smart phone ran out of power before she could photograph the timetable.
entries.zh: 她还没来得及拍下时刻表，智能手机就没电了。

entries.en: In the film, a smoke signal rises above the trees as the search party approaches.
entries.zh: 电影中，搜索队接近时，一道发烟信号从树梢上方升起。

entries.en: The satire imagines every major decision being made in a smoke-filled room.
entries.zh: 那部讽刺作品设想，所有重大决定都是在幕后密谈室里作出的。

entries.en: The sniffer dog paused beside a suitcase while its handler watched quietly.
entries.zh: 嗅探犬在一只手提箱旁停了下来，训导员安静地看着。

entries.en: His friends mistook his interest in local history for social climbing.
entries.zh: 朋友们把他对地方史的兴趣误认为是在攀附权贵。

entries.en: The council discussed repairs to the social housing beside the railway.
entries.zh: 市政会讨论了铁路旁社会住房的维修事宜。

entries.en: Her social life became much quieter after she moved away from the city.
entries.zh: 搬离城市后，她的社交生活平静了许多。

entries.en: The historian examined how the strike challenged the existing social order.
entries.zh: 历史学家考察了那场罢工如何冲击当时的社会秩序。

entries.en: Questions about social security dominated the discussion at the community centre.
entries.zh: 关于社会保障的问题成了社区中心那场讨论的主要内容。

entries.en: The family asked social services for help after losing their home.
entries.zh: 失去住所后，那家人向社会福利服务部门寻求帮助。

entries.en: Our social studies project compared daily life in two fictional towns.
entries.zh: 我们的社会学科项目比较了两个虚构城镇的日常生活。

entries.en: The old soda siphon stood beside a tray of clean glasses on the counter.
entries.zh: 那只旧苏打水压气瓶放在柜台上，旁边是一托盘干净的玻璃杯。

entries.en: We unfolded the sofa-bed after moving the coffee table into the corner.
entries.zh: 我们把茶几挪到角落后，展开了沙发床。

entries.en: The photographer used soft focus for the portrait but kept the background simple.
entries.zh: 摄影师给那幅肖像用了软焦点效果，但背景保持简洁。

entries.meaningZh: 无硬核的小水果〔如草莓〕
entries.en: We bought soft fruit for the tart and saved the apples for another day.
entries.zh: 我们买了无硬核的小水果做馅饼，把苹果留到改天再用。

entries.en: The room still felt unfinished until we added the soft furnishings.
entries.zh: 添上布艺类室内装饰品后，房间才有了布置完毕的感觉。

entries.en: The cooperative rejected the soft loan because it wanted fewer outside obligations.
entries.zh: 那家合作社拒绝了那笔低息贷款，因为它不想承担太多对外义务。

entries.en: The lorry left deep tracks in the soft shoulder beside the road.
entries.zh: 卡车在路边的软质路肩上留下了深深的车辙。

entries.en: The child placed a soft toy on the empty chair beside her.
entries.zh: 孩子把一个毛绒玩具放在身旁的空椅子上。

entries.en: As a sole trader, she kept her invoices in a small cabinet behind the counter.
entries.zh: 作为个体营业者，她把发票存放在柜台后的小文件柜里。

entries.en: The missing sack of letters was found at the sorting office.
entries.zh: 那袋失踪的信件在分拣室里找到了。

entries.en: My older sister played soul music while we painted the kitchen ceiling.
entries.zh: 我们粉刷厨房天花板时，姐姐播放着魂乐。

entries.en: The sound engineer noticed a faint hum that none of the actors had heard.
entries.zh: 录音师发现了轻微的嗡嗡声，演员们却都没有听见。

entries.en: They rebuilt the café inside a sound stage to record the dialogue indoors.
entries.zh: 他们在摄影棚里重建了那家咖啡馆，准备在室内录制对白。

entries.en: The radio advert featured a soundalike rather than the famous singer herself.
entries.zh: 那则电台广告用的是一位声音酷似那位著名女歌手的人，而不是歌手本人。

entries.en: I replaced the soundcard after checking that the speakers worked with another computer.
entries.zh: 确认音箱接在另一台电脑上能用后，我更换了声卡。

entries.en: The children's questions about space flight continued throughout the journey home.
entries.zh: 回家的一路上，孩子们不停地问有关太空飞行的问题。

entries.meaningZh: 意大利制作的西部片〔口语〕
entries.en: The cinema paired an old spaghetti western with a documentary about its director.
entries.zh: 影院把一部老意大利西部片和一部关于其导演的纪录片安排在一起放映。

entries.en: The spare room became a temporary study while her office was being repaired.
entries.zh: 她的办公室维修期间，客房成了临时书房。

entries.en: The mechanic found the spare tyre beneath a pile of camping equipment.
entries.zh: 机修工在一堆露营装备下面找到了备用轮胎。

entries.en: The special offer ended before I had decided which curtains to buy.
entries.zh: 我还没决定买哪幅窗帘，特价优待就结束了。

entries.en: The special school invited families to see the pupils' pottery exhibition.
entries.zh: 那所特殊教育学校邀请各个家庭参观学生的陶艺展。

entries.en: The students compared the spectra recorded before and after the equipment was adjusted.
entries.zh: 学生们比较了设备调整前后记录的光谱。

entries.en: The photograph showed a speed camera partly hidden behind a tree.
entries.zh: 照片中，一个超速摄像头被一棵树挡住了一部分。

entries.en: She tried speed dating once but preferred meeting people through friends.
entries.zh: 她尝试过一次快速配对交友，但还是更喜欢通过朋友认识人。

entries.en: The spellchecker missed the error because both spellings were valid words.
entries.zh: 两个拼法都是有效单词，所以拼写检查程序漏掉了那个错误。

entries.en: His photographs from a weekend of spelunking filled an entire album.
entries.zh: 他周末探察洞穴时拍的照片装满了整本相册。

entries.en: The editor used split-screen to show the two conversations happening at once.
entries.zh: 剪辑师用分画面展示了同时发生的两场谈话。

entries.meaningZh: 旅行用盥洗用品袋〔英式〕
entries.en: I had packed my toothbrush but left the spongebag on the bathroom shelf.
entries.zh: 我已经装好了牙刷，却把盥洗用品袋留在了浴室架子上。

entries.en: Our sports day ended early when a thunderstorm approached the playing fields.
entries.zh: 雷暴逼近运动场时，我们学校的运动日提前结束了。

entries.en: Their disagreement concerned the ethics of spread betting, not the result of the match.
entries.zh: 他们争论的是点差投注的道德问题，而不是比赛结果。

entries.en: She washed the spring greens and left them to drain beside the sink.
entries.zh: 她洗了嫩圆白菜叶，把它们放在水槽旁沥水。

entries.en: The squadron leader found a child's drawing tucked inside the parcel from home.
entries.zh: 那位空军少校在家里寄来的包裹中发现了一幅孩子的画。

entries.en: The stable boy noticed that one of the horses had lost a shoe.
entries.zh: 马童发现，其中一匹马掉了一只蹄铁。

entries.en: A staff nurse showed the new visitor where to leave her coat.
entries.zh: 一位医院护士告诉那位初次来访者可以把外套放在哪里。

entries.en: He asked for a quiet meal rather than an expensive stag night.
entries.zh: 他要求安安静静吃顿饭，而不是办一场花费昂贵的男子婚前聚会。

entries.en: The expedition left spare food at the staging post before continuing inland.
entries.zh: 探险队在补给站留下备用食物后，继续向内陆进发。

entries.en: The delivery team measured the staircase before discussing where the stairlift would fit.
entries.zh: 送货人员先测量了楼梯，再讨论座椅电梯能安装在哪里。

entries.en: In the novel, he enters the election as a stalking horse for another candidate.
entries.zh: 小说中，他作为另一名候选人的掩护性候选人参加选举。

entries.meaningZh: 贴好邮票并写明地址的回邮信封〔英式〕
entries.en: Please include a stamped addressed envelope if you want the original photographs returned.
entries.zh: 如果希望寄回原照片，请附上贴好邮票并写明地址的回邮信封。

entries.en: A standard lamp lit the corner where she repaired the torn sail.
entries.zh: 一盏落地灯照亮了她修补破帆的那个角落。

entries.meaningZh: 池塘〔苏格兰及英格兰北部方言〕
entries.en: Behind the farmhouse, ducks gathered around a small stank.
entries.zh: 农舍后面，鸭子聚集在一个小池塘周围。

entries.en: The star turn arrived late, leaving the rest of the cast increasingly nervous.
entries.zh: 主要演员迟迟才到，让其余演员越来越紧张。

entries.en: The novel follows a family trying to communicate during a state of siege.
entries.zh: 小说讲述了一个家庭在戒严状态下设法传递消息的经历。

entries.en: The state school borrowed costumes from the local theatre for its winter production.
entries.zh: 那所公立学校为冬季演出向当地剧院借了服装。

entries.en: The fictional statelet occupies only a narrow strip of coast on the map.
entries.zh: 地图上，那个虚构的小国只占据一条狭窄的沿海地带。

entries.en: For him, the expensive watch was a status symbol rather than a useful purchase.
entries.zh: 对他来说，那块昂贵手表是社会地位的象征，而不是一件实用品。

entries.en: The steak house was fully booked, so we ate at the café next door.
entries.zh: 牛排馆订满了，于是我们去了隔壁的咖啡馆吃饭。

entries.en: Opponents described the proposed charge as a stealth tax, while its supporters disagreed.
entries.zh: 反对者称拟议中的收费是隐形税，支持者却不同意。

entries.en: The graph showed a step change in the signal when the switch was turned on.
entries.zh: 开关接通时，图上显示信号发生了阶跃变化。

entries.en: A strip of sticky tape held the loose corner of the poster in place.
entries.zh: 一条胶带固定住了海报松开的角。

entries.en: Poor stock control left the shop with too many umbrellas and no raincoats.
entries.zh: 库存管理不善使店里积压了太多雨伞，却没有雨衣。

entries.meaningZh: 头发略带红色的金发女子
entries.en: A strawberry blonde wearing a navy coat returned the keys to reception.
entries.zh: 一位穿深蓝色外套、金发略带红色的女子把钥匙还给了接待处。

entries.en: The volunteers asked the street people what supplies they needed most.
entries.zh: 志愿者询问那些街头流浪者最需要哪些物资。

entries.en: The stretch limo could not turn into the narrow lane outside the assembly hall.
entries.zh: 那辆超长豪华轿车无法拐进礼堂外的狭窄小巷。

entries.en: The portrait showed the stretch marks left by her pregnancy.
entries.zh: 那幅肖像画出了她怀孕后留下的妊娠纹。

entries.en: In the novel, the strike-breaker refuses to speak to the men outside the factory.
entries.zh: 小说中，那个顶替罢工者工作的人拒绝与工厂外的那些男子说话。

entries.en: The final panel of the strip cartoon made the whole waiting room laugh.
entries.zh: 连环漫画的最后一格让整个等候室的人都笑了起来。

entries.en: The film's opening scene takes place outside a closed strip club.
entries.zh: 电影的开场发生在一家关着门的脱衣舞夜总会外。

entries.en: He mistook the theatre's old rehearsal room for a strip joint.
entries.zh: 他把剧院的旧排练室误当成了脱衣舞俱乐部。

entries.en: One strip light above the stage began flickering during the rehearsal.
entries.zh: 排练时，舞台上方的一盏条形照明灯开始闪烁。

entries.en: The structural engineer requested the original drawings before examining the damaged balcony.
entries.zh: 结构工程师要求先取得原始图纸，再检查受损的阳台。

entries.en: A small stuffed animal fell out when he opened the suitcase.
entries.zh: 他打开手提箱时，一个小小的填充玩具动物掉了出来。

entries.en: The sub-editor caught a misleading headline just before the page went to print.
entries.zh: 那页付印前，审校人及时发现了一个误导性的标题。

entries.en: The museum displayed an unloaded sub-machine gun behind a glass barrier.
entries.zh: 博物馆在玻璃屏障后展示了一支未装弹的冲锋枪。

entries.en: The sub-plot about a missing necklace never quite fits the main story.
entries.zh: 关于项链失踪的那条次要情节始终不太融入主线故事。

entries.en: The substitute teacher found yesterday's instructions beneath a stack of exercise books.
entries.zh: 代课教师在一叠练习本下面找到了昨天的说明。

entries.en: The restored cinema became a success story that encouraged other small businesses nearby.
entries.zh: 修复后的影院成了一个成功事例，鼓舞了附近其他小企业。

entries.en: She dropped one sugar lump into the cup and stirred slowly.
entries.zh: 她往杯里放了一块糖，慢慢搅动。

entries.en: The officer in the film refused to release the suicide note before the investigation ended.
entries.zh: 电影中的警官拒绝在调查结束前公布那封绝命书。

entries.en: The timetable used summer time, but the old kitchen clock had not been adjusted.
entries.zh: 时刻表用的是夏令时，但厨房里的旧钟还没有调过来。

entries.en: By sun-up, the fishing boats had already disappeared beyond the headland.
entries.zh: 日出时，渔船早已消失在岬角的另一边。

entries.en: Sunbathing did not interest her, so she spent the afternoon sketching under a tree.
entries.zh: 她对日光浴不感兴趣，于是在树下画了一下午的速写。

entries.en: The gym removed the old sunbed during its renovation.
entries.zh: 健身房装修时移走了那张旧太阳灯浴床。

entries.meaningZh: 超级迷你电脑〔计算机类型〕
entries.en: In the archive, a photograph showed the supermini beside its operator's terminal.
entries.zh: 档案里的一张照片显示，那台超级迷你电脑旁边放着操作员的终端。

entries.en: A supply teacher took the morning classes while the regular teacher attended a meeting.
entries.zh: 正式任课教师开会期间，一位代课教师上了上午的课。

entries.en: At the support group, nobody pressed her to speak before she felt ready.
entries.zh: 在互助小组里，没人催她在准备好之前发言。

entries.en: The letter listed the policy's surrender value but did not explain the calculation.
entries.zh: 信中列出了保单的退保金额，却没有解释计算方法。

entries.en: The novel's closing chapter reveals that he received a suspended sentence.
entries.zh: 小说最后一章透露，他被判处的刑罚获缓期执行。

entries.en: He replaced the swear word with a dash before sending the message.
entries.zh: 发消息前，他用一道横线替换了那句脏话。

entries.en: The swearing-in was delayed when the new mayor's train failed to arrive.
entries.zh: 新市长的火车未能到达，宣誓就职仪式因此推迟了。

entries.en: We waited beside the canal while the swing bridge opened for a barge.
entries.zh: 平转桥转开让一艘驳船通过时，我们在运河边等着。

entries.en: With the committee evenly divided, her swing vote decided the result.
entries.zh: 委员会双方票数持平，她的关键一票决定了结果。

entries.en: My swipe card was still in yesterday's jacket, which I had left at home.
entries.zh: 我的磁卡还在昨天穿的外套里，而那件外套被我留在了家中。

entries.en: She missed synchronized swimming and hoped to rejoin her old team.
entries.zh: 她很想念同游表演，也希望重新加入原来的队伍。

entries.en: The venue advertised table dancing, so we chose somewhere quieter for dinner.
entries.zh: 那家场所宣传有桌前艳舞，于是我们选了更安静的地方吃晚饭。

entries.en: His table manners improved after he began eating with the other students.
entries.zh: 开始与其他学生一起用餐后，他的餐桌礼仪有所改善。

entries.en: The debate about tactical voting continued long after the meeting ended.
entries.zh: 会议结束很久后，关于策略性投票的争论仍在继续。

entries.en: A cracked tail-light was the only visible damage to the parked car.
entries.zh: 那辆停着的汽车唯一看得见的损坏是一盏破裂的尾灯。

entries.en: Her accordion performance was the surprise highlight of the school's talent show.
entries.zh: 她的手风琴表演意外成为学校新秀演出中的亮点。

entries.meaningZh: 只说不做的清谈会〔贬义〕
entries.en: Residents feared the new committee would become another talking shop.
entries.zh: 居民们担心，新委员会会成为又一个只说不做的清谈会。

entries.en: He received a talking-to for leaving the storeroom unlocked overnight.
entries.zh: 因为让储藏室整夜没锁，他挨了一顿申斥。

entries.en: A square-rigged tall ship appeared on the cover of the history magazine.
entries.zh: 那本历史杂志的封面上出现了一艘高桅横帆船。

entries.meaningZh: 汽车圆形完税标志〔英国旧制〕
entries.en: An old tax disc remained stuck to the windscreen of the abandoned car.
entries.zh: 那辆废弃汽车的挡风玻璃上还贴着一张旧的圆形完税标志。

entries.en: She separated the receipts by tax year before putting them in labelled folders.
entries.zh: 她先按纳税年度分开收据，再把它们放进贴有标签的文件夹。

entries.en: The hotel moved the tea dance into the garden when the weather cleared.
entries.zh: 天气放晴后，酒店把下午茶舞会移到了花园里。

entries.en: We sheltered from the shower in a tea shop opposite the station.
entries.zh: 我们在车站对面的一家茶馆躲避阵雨。

entries.en: The teaching hospital lent its lecture theatre to the visiting orchestra.
entries.zh: 教学医院把阶梯教室借给了来访的管弦乐队。

entries.en: During teaching practice, she often ran out of time before reaching the final exercise.
entries.zh: 教学实习期间，她常常还没讲到最后一道练习，时间就不够了。

entries.en: A reliable team player can disagree without making every discussion personal.
entries.zh: 一个可靠、有团队精神的人可以表达不同意见，而不把每次讨论都变成针对个人的争执。

entries.en: I expected a tear-jerker, but the story ended with an unexpectedly dry joke.
entries.zh: 我原以为那会是个催人泪下的故事，结尾却出人意料地来了句冷笑话。

entries.en: The technical college borrowed our workshop while its own building was being repaired.
entries.zh: 那所技术类专科学校的校舍维修期间，借用了我们的车间。

entries.en: Technical support asked for a photograph of the error message rather than another description.
entries.zh: 技术支持人员要求提供报错信息的照片，而不是再作一次描述。

entries.en: The booking system's teething problems left several guests waiting for their room keys.
entries.zh: 预订系统的初期问题让几位客人不得不等候领取房间钥匙。

entries.en: Their bicycle repair business survived its teething troubles and finally hired an assistant.
entries.zh: 他们的自行车维修店挺过了创业阶段的困难，终于雇了一名助手。

entries.en: After a year in telesales, she wanted a job that involved meeting customers in person.
entries.zh: 做了一年电话销售后，她想找一份能够与顾客当面接触的工作。

entries.en: The teleworker moved her desk away from the window to avoid the afternoon glare.
entries.zh: 那位远程工作者把书桌挪离窗户，以避开下午刺眼的光线。

entries.en: The puppy ignored the telling-off and carried another slipper into the garden.
entries.zh: 小狗不理那顿训斥，又叼了一只拖鞋到花园里。

entries.en: The committee refused to investigate matters outside its terms of reference.
entries.zh: 委员会拒绝调查超出其授权范围的事项。

entries.en: Texting during the rehearsal annoyed the conductor more than the occasional wrong note.
entries.zh: 排练时发短信比偶尔奏错音符更让指挥恼火。

entries.en: They stored the dry thatching beneath a tarpaulin until the roof was ready.
entries.zh: 屋顶准备好之前，他们把干燥的草质盖顶材料存放在防水布下。

entries.en: She spent the best part of the afternoon untangling the cables.
entries.zh: 她花了大半个下午解开缠在一起的电缆。

entries.meaningZh: 终于使人无法忍受的最后一击
entries.en: The third cancelled appointment was the last straw, and she changed dentists.
entries.zh: 第三次预约又被取消，终于让她忍无可忍，于是她换了牙医。

entries.en: The designer offered advice, but the client had the last word on the colours.
entries.zh: 设计师提出了建议，但颜色的最后决定权在客户手中。

entries.en: The report made little sense to the man in the street without a technical background.
entries.zh: 对没有技术背景的普通人而言，那份报告很难理解。

entries.en: She wished she could preserve the moment for a little longer.
entries.zh: 她希望能把那一刻保留得再久一点。

entries.en: For this delicate repair, patience is the name of the game.
entries.zh: 做这项精细维修，耐心是关键。

entries.en: The chair read the order of the day before anyone proposed an amendment.
entries.zh: 主席先宣读了议事日程，然后才有人提出修正案。

entries.en: The little radio was their only link with the outside world during the storm.
entries.zh: 暴风雨期间，那台小收音机是他们与外界唯一的联系。

entries.en: Of all the cottages we visited, the riverside one was the pick of the bunch.
entries.zh: 我们看过的所有村舍中，河边那间是最好的。

entries.meaningZh: 当局〔常带诙谐或讽刺语气〕
entries.en: The powers that be rejected our request for a later closing time.
entries.zh: 当局驳回了我们延后关门时间的申请。

entries.en: His essay on the survival of the fittest provoked a lively discussion after class.
entries.zh: 他那篇讨论适者生存的文章引发了课后热烈的讨论。

entries.term: the thin end of the wedge
entries.en: Residents feared the small charge was the thin end of the wedge.
entries.zh: 居民们担心，这笔小额收费会成为得寸进尺的开端。

entries.en: After the equalizer, our team gradually gained the upper hand.
entries.zh: 扳平比分后，我们队逐渐占了上风。

entries.en: The narrator reveals that the kindly host is actually the villain of the piece.
entries.zh: 叙述者透露，那位和善的主人其实才是故事中的首恶。
